title.zh: 物价为什么会涨，又为什么会跌
title.en: What Makes Prices Rise, and Fall

desc.zh: 通胀和通缩是怎么来的：印钱为什么时灵时不灵，需求拉动和成本推动，菲利普斯曲线和预期，工资物价螺旋，财政与铸币税，债务通缩，日本和中国的低通胀，恶性通胀，以及 2021–2026 年两轮通胀的分解证据。六个可以拖动的模型和三张真实数据图。
desc.en: Where inflation and deflation come from: why printing money sometimes moves prices and sometimes does not, demand-pull and cost-push, the Phillips curve and expectations, wage–price spirals, deficits and seigniorage, debt deflation, low inflation in Japan and China, hyperinflation, and the evidence that decomposes the 2021–2026 inflations. Six models to drag and three charts of real data.

title.zh: 需求拉动与成本推动：两种通胀
title.en: Demand-pull and cost-push: two kinds of inflation

desc.zh: 物价和产出同向走是需求冲击，反向走是供给冲击；需求冲击能被政策抵消，供给冲击只能在通胀和产出之间取舍。
desc.en: Prices and output moving together signal a demand shock, moving apart a supply shock; policy can offset the first but only trade off inflation against output in the second.

zh: 能源涨价为什么会通胀
为什么2021年美国通胀那么高
相对价格和通胀的区别
en: why was inflation so high in 2021

title.zh: 菲利普斯曲线的斜率：变平、移动和弯曲的证据
title.en: The Phillips curve's slope: evidence that it flattened, shifted and bends

desc.zh: 美国 1960–2025 年失业率与通胀的关系在四个年代给出四种斜率；附加预期的菲利普斯曲线解释了它为什么会整条移动，2021 年后它是否变陡仍有争议。
desc.en: US unemployment and inflation give four different slopes in four eras since 1960; the expectations-augmented curve explains why it shifts, and whether it steepened after 2021 is still debated.

zh: 附加预期的菲利普斯曲线

desc.zh: 人们对未来通胀的预期会通过工资和定价变成真的；1970 年代预期松动，2021–2023 年长期预期基本被锚住，可信度决定压通胀的代价。
desc.en: Expected inflation becomes real through wages and price-setting; expectations came loose in the 1970s but long-run expectations stayed anchored in 2021–2023, and credibility sets the cost of disinflation.

title.zh: 工资–物价螺旋与压通胀的代价
title.en: Wage–price spirals and the cost of disinflation

desc.zh: 能源冲击后工资追物价只会延长通胀、补不回实际工资；预期锚住时螺旋通常自己停下，牺牲率取决于可信度。
desc.en: After an energy shock, wages chasing prices prolong inflation without restoring real wages; with anchored expectations spirals usually stop, and the sacrifice ratio depends on credibility.

title.zh: 通缩与债务通缩：日本与中国
title.en: Deflation and debt deflation: Japan and China

desc.zh: 物价下跌让固定数字的债更重，费雪的债务–通缩循环可以自我加速；日本 1990 年代以来和中国 2023–2025 年是两段长期低通胀，原因有几种并存的解释。
desc.en: Falling prices make fixed nominal debt heavier and Fisher's debt-deflation loop can feed on itself; Japan since the 1990s and China in 2023–2025 are two long low-inflation episodes with competing explanations.

desc.zh: 印钱填赤字是一种以通胀为税率的税，它有上限；赤字超过上限，通胀就没有稳定的位置，德国 1923 年、津巴布韦 2008 年都是靠财政改革加新货币锚才结束的。
desc.en: Printing money to cover a deficit is a tax with inflation as its rate, and it has a ceiling; above it inflation has no resting point, and Germany in 1923 and Zimbabwe in 2008 ended only with fiscal reform plus a new monetary anchor.

zh: 不愉快的货币主义算术

desc.zh: Bernanke–Blanchard、Shapiro 的需求/供给分解、财政估计，以及 2025 年关税与 2026 年能源冲击的价格证据，各自的结论和分歧。
desc.en: Bernanke–Blanchard, Shapiro's demand/supply split, fiscal estimates, and price evidence from the 2025 tariffs and the 2026 energy shock: what each finds and where they disagree.
